answer: An adversary running 165 aliases hence needs 91 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in horizon, expire in umber, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1844 identities would post 2075 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
